# Agentic leads

Find prospects from places, files, and feeds.

SDK: findLeads, GooglePlacesAdapter, ApifyAdapter, ApolloAdapter,
CountyFileAdapter, StormFeedAdapter.
CLI: agentic-leads search --query "services"; defaults to a dry run.
MCP: search_leads, list_sources, get_cost_report.
Docs: https://github.com/pooriaarab/agentic-leads
Core: https://github.com/pooriaarab/agentic-leads/blob/main/docs/agentic-core.md
License: MIT
